newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian bus driver kills traffic cop over ticket.
newsitem.headline: Colombian bus driver kills traffic cop over ticket.

text.p: A Colombian bus driver was so furious about getting a summons for a minor traffic offence that he used his bus to kill the policeman who handed it to him, local news reports said on Saturday.

Bogota's El Espectador newspaper quoted witnesses as saying the driver, identified as Fernando Mellizo, turned his passenger bus on the traffic cop and ran him down deliberately, minutes after receiving the ticket.
The policeman, Dario Rojas, was walking toward his motorcyle and had turned his back on the city bus, when Mellizo gunned its engine and ran him down, El Espectador said.
